# API contract

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m keelgate._internal.apidoc`. Do not edit: change the code or keelgate/_internal/api.py and regenerate. -->

Every public symbol of Keelgate, generated from the code. The public API is exactly what the modules below export; every other module is private (underscored) and every name not listed here is private whatever it is called. The narrative, the semantics and an end-to-end example are in the [integration contract](integration-contract.md); the policy for changing anything on this page is in [versioning](versioning.md).

**stable**: covered by semantic versioning; a breaking change needs a major bump (a minor bump while Keelgate is 0.x) and a migration note. **provisional**: works and is tested, but may change in a minor release with a changelog entry.

A change to this file in a pull request *is* a change to the public API.
